verdict_summary: The merge of main does not change the PR's patch: the stable patch-id is identical before and after. Main's changes (AILANG v0.56.1, star-names entry, replay version strings) do not touch the publish recipe, the test, or the test:/ci-fast: lines. capture-m4-publish-test passes on both GNU Make 3.81 and 4.4.1 in under 2 s. It is a prerequisite of both make test and make ci-fast. The real recipe makes zero gcloud calls when any file is missing. The test killed 7 of 11 of my mutants, including the key ones: moving the check after the upload, dropping the shasum check, dropping the worlds check or file, and a no-op fake gcloud. The survivors are redundant or minor count checks. Mergeable.
